title: Acts Chapter 7 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Acts chapter 7 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Acts Chapter 7 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Acts Chapter 7.

questions.question: Who did the high priest question at the beginning of Acts 7?
questions.explanation: The high priest questioned Stephen about the accusations against him. (Acts 7:1)

questions.question: Where did God appear to Abraham according to Acts 7?
questions.explanation: The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia. (Acts 7:2)

questions.question: What command did God give to Abraham?
options: Get thee out of thy country
questions.correctAnswer: Get thee out of thy country
questions.explanation: God commanded Abraham to get out of his country and kindred. (Acts 7:3)

questions.question: True or False: Abraham received an inheritance in the land God promised him.
questions.explanation: Abraham received none inheritance in the land, not even enough to set his foot on. (Acts 7:5)

questions.question: What did God say would happen to Abraham's seed?
options: They would inherit the land immediately
They would be free in 100 years
They should sojourn in a strange land
questions.correctAnswer: They should sojourn in a strange land
questions.explanation: God spoke that Abraham's seed would sojourn in a strange land and be in bondage. (Acts 7:6)

questions.question: Who sold Joseph into Egypt?
questions.explanation: The patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt. (Acts 7:9)

questions.question: True or False: Jacob sent his sons to Egypt to find sustenance during a famine.
questions.explanation: Jacob sent his sons to Egypt because there was corn there during the dearth. (Acts 7:12)

questions.question: How many souls did Jacob bring down into Egypt?
questions.explanation: Jacob went down into Egypt with threescore and fifteen souls, which is seventy. (Acts 7:14)

questions.question: What did the king who arose in Egypt not know?
questions.explanation: Another king arose in Egypt which knew not Joseph. (Acts 7:18)

questions.question: True or False: Moses was raised in his own home for three months before being taken by Pharaoh's daughter.
questions.explanation: Moses was nourished up in his father's house for three months. (Acts 7:20-21)

questions.question: In what order did Moses first intervene when he saw an Egyptian smiting a Hebrew?
questions.explanation: Moses defended the oppressed Hebrew and smote the Egyptian. (Acts 7:24)

medium.title: Acts Chapter 7 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Acts Chapter 7 to real-life situations.

questions.question: Who nourished Moses after he was cast out?
questions.explanation: Moses was taken up and nourished by Pharaoh's daughter as stated in Acts 7:21.

questions.question: What did Moses do when he saw an Egyptian smiting a Hebrew?
questions.explanation: Moses defended the oppressed Hebrew and smote the Egyptian, as mentioned in Acts 7:24.

questions.question: What did Moses believe about his brethren after killing the Egyptian?
questions.explanation: Moses thought that his brethren would understand that God would deliver them through him, as stated in Acts 7:25.

questions.question: When did Moses receive the call to deliver the Israelites?
options: When he was in the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: When he was in the wilderness
questions.explanation: Moses was called to deliver the Israelites when he encountered the angel of the Lord in the wilderness, as described in Acts 7:30.

questions.question: What did God command Moses to do at the burning bush?
questions.explanation: God commanded Moses to take off his shoes because he was standing on holy ground, as noted in Acts 7:33.

questions.question: True or False: Moses was rejected by the Israelites when he first tried to help them.
questions.explanation: Moses was rejected by his brethren, who asked him who made him a ruler and judge over them, as referenced in Acts 7:27.

questions.question: How did the Israelites respond to Moses' attempts to help them?
questions.explanation: The Israelites questioned Moses' authority by asking who made him a ruler and judge over them, as stated in Acts 7:27.

questions.question: What did Moses do after he fled from the Israelites?
questions.explanation: Moses fled to the land of Midian where he became a stranger and begat two sons, as mentioned in Acts 7:29.

questions.question: What does Acts 7:34 reveal about God's view on the affliction of His people?
questions.explanation: God saw the affliction of His people in Egypt and heard their groaning, indicating His compassion and intention to deliver them, as stated in Acts 7:34.

questions.question: True or False: God sent Moses to be a ruler and deliverer after he was rejected by the Israelites.
questions.explanation: Despite being rejected, God sent Moses to be a ruler and deliverer, as affirmed in Acts 7:35.

questions.question: What was the attitude of the Israelites towards Moses in their hearts?
questions.explanation: The Israelites turned back to Egypt in their hearts, showing their lack of faith in Moses and God's plan, as noted in Acts 7:39.

questions.question: What did God do when the people worshipped idols in the wilderness?
options: He turned and gave them up
questions.correctAnswer: He turned and gave them up
questions.explanation: God gave them up to worship the host of heaven when they turned away from Him, as stated in Acts 7:42.

hard.title: Acts Chapter 7 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Acts Chapter 7.

questions.question: Who did God appear to in Mesopotamia according to Acts 7?
questions.explanation: God appeared to Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia as stated in Acts 7:2.

questions.question: What did God promise to Abraham regarding his descendants?
options: They would become a great nation
questions.explanation: God promised Abraham that He would give the land to him and his seed after him as noted in Acts 7:5.

questions.question: According to Acts 7, how long would Israel be in bondage?
questions.explanation: God indicated that Abraham's seed would sojourn in a strange land and be in bondage for 400 years in Acts 7:6.

questions.question: Which figure was sold into Egypt by his brothers?
questions.explanation: The patriarchs sold Joseph into Egypt out of envy, as stated in Acts 7:9.

questions.question: What did Moses do when he saw an Egyptian smiting a Hebrew?
questions.explanation: Moses defended the wronged Hebrew and smote the Egyptian as mentioned in Acts 7:24.

questions.question: What did God tell Moses to do when He appeared to him in the burning bush?
questions.explanation: God instructed Moses to put off his shoes, declaring the ground holy in Acts 7:33.

questions.question: What did the people do when they thought Moses had died?
questions.explanation: The people made a calf and offered sacrifices to it when they thought Moses was gone as stated in Acts 7:41.

questions.question: Which king arose that did not know Joseph?
questions.explanation: Another king arose in Egypt who did not know Joseph, as mentioned in Acts 7:18.

questions.question: What did Stephen see while full of the Holy Ghost?
questions.explanation: Stephen saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God, as recorded in Acts 7:55.

questions.question: True or False: The Most High dwells in temples made with hands.
questions.explanation: Acts 7:48 states that the Most High does not dwell in temples made with hands, indicating a spiritual rather than physical dwelling.

questions.question: True or False: Stephen asked God to lay not the sin of those stoning him to their charge.
questions.explanation: Stephen prayed to God to not lay the sin to their charge, as shown in Acts 7:60.

questions.question: What significant theme does Acts 7 share with Exodus 32 regarding idolatry?
questions.explanation: Both Acts 7:41 and Exodus 32 discuss the people making a calf to worship while Moses was on the mountain, indicating their inclination towards idolatry.

questions.question: Which Old Testament prophet echoed the sentiment found in Acts 7:42 about the people's worship?
questions.explanation: Amos 5:25-27 reflects the rejection of true worship and the people's turn towards idolatry, paralleling Acts 7:42.

questions.question: In Acts 7:51, what term is used to describe the people’s resistance to the Holy Ghost?
questions.explanation: The term 'stiffnecked' describes the people's persistent resistance to the Holy Spirit, as noted in Acts 7:51.

questions.question: What does the Greek word for 'church' in Acts 7:38 suggest about the people during the wilderness?
questions.explanation: The Greek word for 'church' indicates an assembly, highlighting the communal aspect of the Israelites in the wilderness in Acts 7:38.

theological.title: Acts Chapter 7 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Acts Chapter 7 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What promise did God make to Abraham regarding the land?
options: He would give it to Abraham's seed after him
He would give it to Abraham immediately
He would not give it to anyone
He would take it away from Abraham
questions.correctAnswer: He would give it to Abraham's seed after him
questions.explanation: God promised Abraham that He would give the land to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, as stated in Acts 7:5.

questions.question: How long did God predict that Abraham's seed would be in bondage?
questions.explanation: God spoke that Abraham's seed should sojourn in a strange land and that they would be in bondage for four hundred years (Acts 7:6).

questions.question: What was the relationship between Joseph and the patriarchs?
options: They sold him into Egypt out of envy
questions.correctAnswer: They sold him into Egypt out of envy
questions.explanation: The patriarchs were moved with envy and sold Joseph into Egypt, as stated in Acts 7:9.

questions.question: What did God do for Joseph while he was in Egypt?
options: He gave him favor and wisdom
He turned his back on him
questions.correctAnswer: He gave him favor and wisdom
questions.explanation: God was with Joseph, delivering him from all his afflictions and giving him favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh (Acts 7:10).

questions.question: What did Moses do when he saw an Egyptian smiting a Hebrew?
options: He defended the Hebrew and smote the Egyptian
questions.correctAnswer: He defended the Hebrew and smote the Egyptian
questions.explanation: Moses saw one of his brethren suffer wrong, defended him, and smote the Egyptian who was oppressing him (Acts 7:24).

questions.question: Which attribute of God is revealed when He appears to Moses in the burning bush?
questions.explanation: God told Moses to take off his shoes because the place where he stood was holy ground, indicating God's holiness (Acts 7:33).

questions.question: What did God say He would do in response to the affliction of His people in Egypt?
questions.explanation: God said He had seen the affliction of His people in Egypt and had come down to deliver them (Acts 7:34).

questions.question: How did the people respond to Moses when he tried to help them?
questions.explanation: When Moses tried to reconcile two brethren, one rejected him and asked who made him a ruler and judge (Acts 7:27).

questions.question: What did the Israelites do while in the wilderness according to Stephen's speech?
options: They made a calf and worshipped it
questions.correctAnswer: They made a calf and worshipped it
questions.explanation: In the wilderness, they made a calf and offered sacrifices to it, as stated in Acts 7:41.

questions.question: What does Acts 7:48 reveal about God's dwelling?
options: He dwells in temples made with hands
He dwells in the hearts of believers
He does not dwell in temples made with hands
questions.correctAnswer: He does not dwell in temples made with hands
questions.explanation: Acts 7:48 states that the most High dwells not in temples made with hands, emphasizing His transcendence beyond human structures.

questions.question: What does the phrase 'stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears' refer to?
questions.explanation: This phrase describes the people's resistance to the Holy Ghost and rebellion against God, as seen in Acts 7:51.

questions.question: What did Stephen see as he was being stoned?
questions.explanation: Stephen, full of the Holy Ghost, looked into heaven and saw the heavens opened, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God (Acts 7:55-56).

questions.question: What message did Stephen convey regarding the prophets?
options: They were persecuted by their fathers
questions.correctAnswer: They were persecuted by their fathers
questions.explanation: Stephen pointed out that the prophets were persecuted by their fathers, which shows a historical pattern of rejection (Acts 7:52).

questions.question: What does Acts 7:53 say about the law?
options: It was given by angels and not kept
questions.correctAnswer: It was given by angels and not kept
questions.explanation: The verse states that the people received the law by the disposition of angels but did not keep it, highlighting their failure to obey (Acts 7:53).

questions.question: What claim can skeptics make about the law given to Israel?
options: It was given to unite them
It was too difficult to follow
It was irrelevant to their salvation
It was given by angels but not kept
questions.correctAnswer: It was given by angels but not kept
questions.explanation: Skeptics might claim that the law was irrelevant or burdensome, but Acts 7:53 clarifies that it was given by angels and highlights Israel's disobedience.
